no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting was necessary or held, as the application did not present novel issues which merited advisory committee input.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for Xeglyze (NDA206966). The Summary Review states no AC meeting was necessary or held because the application did not present novel issues meriting AC input, and the Medical Review confirms there were no complex scientific or regulatory issues requiring an Advisory Committee. With no meeting held, there are no committee concerns linked to changes in the approval.
